name: leisure-time-queue
description: Durable LeisureTimeQueue plugin for DeepSeek Harness

interface.shortDescription: Run queued Harness tasks during user-defined time windows.
interface.longDescription: LeisureTimeQueue is a native Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness that persists one-shot tasks, dispatches them during user-defined weekly execution windows, and exposes task management tools to the agent.
defaultPrompt: Create a LeisureTimeQueue task for this repository.
Configure the weekly time windows when queued work may start.
